instruction: Please convert all the text in the document to UPPERCASE.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting all text to UPPERCASE. Evaluator checks that >= 99% of alphabetic characters are uppercase.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts the docx file from VM using get_vm_file getter
Postconfig properly saves the document with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring latest state is captured
Metric logic correctly counts alphabetic characters and calculates uppercase percentage
99% threshold is reasonable and allows for minor edge cases or formatting artifacts
Expected value structure (type: rule with empty rules) is appropriate for this boolean-style check
Minor limitation: Only checks text in paragraph runs, may miss text in tables, headers, footers, text boxes, or footnotes
For typical documents where most text is in paragraphs, the evaluator will work correctly
The 99% threshold provides some tolerance for unchecked elements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider extending the function to also check tables: iterate through doc.tables and check cell text
Consider checking headers and footers: iterate through doc.sections and check header/footer text
Example enhancement: for table in doc.tables: for row in table.rows: for cell in row.cells: check cell.text
However, for most real-world documents, the current implementation should be sufficient
